default.description: Default capabilities for Utsuwa. http:default intentionally allows any http/https URL: MCP servers are configured by the user at runtime and the desktop build must reach them directly, since the plugin bypasses webview CORS (which the MCP feature relies on). fs:allow-read-file has no static allow list on purpose: tauri-plugin-fs adds drag-and-dropped paths to its scope at runtime, which is the only way the app reads user files.
